article.story: LOS ANGELES -- — Rodney Rice had 24 points and seven assists, Alijah Arenas scored 19 and No. 18 Southern California dominated from the outset to remain perfect this season with a 96-51 victory over Tarleton State on Thursday night. Jacob Cofie added 13 points, Adonis Ratliff had 10 and Darius Ratliff grabbed nine rebounds as the Trojans (5-0) followed up a 76-point blowout against Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Sunday with a 45-point win on coach Eric Musselman’s 62nd birthday. USC shot 53.7% from the floor overall, and 13 of 26 from 3-point range, after shooting 64.3% in the first half. Rice went 5 of 9 from long distance, while Arenas was 5 of 9 overall and has shot 50% or better in all five games. Franck Emmou scored 14 points and Brett Freeman added 13 for the Texans (4-2), who were facing the first of two power-conference opponents on their schedule, with a matchup at Pittsburgh on Dec. 5. Tarleton State shot 33.3% from the field, and 13.3% from 3-point range (2 of 15). The Trojans went on a 9-2 run to open a 19-9 advantage, with Arenas scoring seven points in that stretch. An 18-2 spurt late in the first half gave USC a 49-17 lead. Arenas had 15 points in the first half while going 4 of 6 from the floor as the Trojans went into the break with a 55-21 lead. They built their cushion to 80-40 with 6:08 remaining and led by as many as 48 in the second half. Both losses for the Texans losses have come in Southern California. They were beaten 96-90 in overtime at San Diego on Nov. 6. Up next Tarleton State visits Weber State next Tuesday. USC hosts Louisiana on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
